title: aster microcephalus f. humilis
intro: Aster microcephalus f. humilis, commonly known as small-headed aster, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Aster microcephalus f. humilis include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as pain, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
